searchText: Hey guys, is Proof of Custody still in scope now that we have DAS and KZG? I'm trying to wrap my head around https://ethresear.ch/t/1-bit-aggregation-friendly-custody-bonds/2236 and having a very hard time with this. I wouldn't want to spend my precious brain cycles on something that's no longer relevant. it is still very much in scope the proof of custody scheme guarantees consensus actors have certain data over some time frame namely the beacon committees make sure to check out dankrad's 0.001 extension of that original piece. something like this we expect to go to mainnet https://ethresear.ch/t/a-0-001-bit-proof-of-custody/7409 DAS is layered on top to let clients decide locally if some data is available and complements the custody games
